storeSettings.title: Store Configuration
storeSettings.subtitle: Manage global location, validation, and blacklist settings for your stores.
storeSettings.globalDescription: Enable this to broadcast the configuration below to every connected store. Disable to select a specific store.
storeSettings.locationSectionSubtitle: Manage your store's physical address and region
storeSettings.amazonTaxRateDesc: Estimated Amazon sales-tax rate applied to the purchase cost. Used two ways: it raises your eBay listing price so this cost is covered, and — while an order's profit is still provisional and the Amazon order has not yet been placed — it estimates that order's profit.
storeSettings.autoFulfillEnabled: Automatically place Amazon orders after eBay sales
storeSettings.autoFulfillEnabledHint: When on, SellerHill buys the item on Amazon with your linked buyer account. Disable to order manually.
storeSettings.autoFulfillEnabledInfo: Enable this only after connecting and configuring an Amazon buyer account. Automatic ordering also requires that account's auto-fulfillment setting and spending cap to be enabled.

lossLimit.enabled: Stop automatic orders that would lose money
lossLimit.enabledHint: When on, an automatic order is stopped before buying if the Amazon total is higher than your eBay payout by more than the amount below. The order then waits for you. Off by default. A store without its own limit uses the global one.
lossLimit.amountHint: In your store's currency. 0 means never buy at a loss.

storeSettings.trackingConversionProviderHint: Real carrier numbers are forwarded as-is. Amazon Logistics (TBA) passes through unchanged.
storeSettings.trackingConversionApiComingSoon: An API-based conversion provider is on the roadmap.

messaging.title: Buyer messages
messaging.subtitle: Automatically message buyers at key order moments. Optional and per event.
messaging.shippedWarning: eBay already sends a tracking notification when an order is marked shipped. Sending another is optional.

eventDescriptions.order_received: Sends the selected message when a new matched eBay order is first received.
eventDescriptions.shipped: Sends the selected message after Amazon tracking marks the order as shipped. eBay also sends its own tracking notification.
eventDescriptions.delivered: Sends the selected message when Amazon tracking confirms delivery.
eventDescriptions.feedback_request: Sends the selected feedback request a chosen number of days after delivery.

addNew.title: New Message Template
addNew.subtitle: Write a custom message for an order event

list.title: Message Templates
list.subtitle: View, edit, or create your automated buyer message templates
list.empty: No templates for this event yet
list.emptyDescription: Create a template to use your own wording for buyer messaging events.

create.title: New Message Template
create.subtitle: Write a custom message for an order event

templates.name: Name
templates.resetConfirm: Restore the original default message? Your edits to the text will be lost.
templates.deleteConfirmDescription: This will permanently delete "{{name}}". If a messaging event is currently using it, that event will stop sending until you pick another template.

storeSettings.trackingConversionEnabledHint: Your buyer sees a new tracking number issued by our tracking partner instead of the original Amazon one, so nothing on eBay points back to your supplier. If a number cannot be converted we never fall back to the Amazon one — the order is held and shown to you in the Action Center instead.
storeSettings.trackingConversionScopeHint: Amazon Logistics (TBA) numbers say "Amazon" outright, so converting only those hides the clearest sign of your supplier and uses far less of your monthly conversion allowance. Converting every carrier hides more — an Amazon-shipped UPS or USPS number can often be looked up — but costs more, and eBay treats a native carrier scan as stronger proof of delivery if a buyer claims their item never arrived.
storeSettings.trackingConvertManualOrdersHint: An order counts as linked by hand whenever SellerHill did not make the Amazon purchase itself: you bought it and entered the order number, or the system matched it for you. If automatic ordering is off, every one of your orders falls into this group — so turning this off means no tracking number is converted at all and your buyer sees the raw Amazon one. On by default; with it off you can still convert these orders one at a time from the order page.

trackingExposure.conversionOff: Tracking-number conversion is off. Your buyers see Amazon's raw tracking number (TBA…) and can trace your supplier directly.
trackingExposure.manualAll: Because automatic ordering is off, EVERY one of your orders counts as linked by hand. With this setting off nothing is converted — the raw Amazon number, TBA included, goes to eBay and exposes your supplier.
trackingExposure.manualSome: Orders you link by hand will ship with the raw Amazon tracking number (TBA…), exposing your supplier on those orders.
trackingExposure.confirmConversionOff: If you turn conversion off, every order from now on shows your buyer the raw Amazon tracking number (TBA…) and exposes your supplier. Once a tracking number has been sent to eBay it cannot be changed. Are you sure you want to turn it off?
trackingExposure.confirmManualOff: If you turn this off, orders you link by hand will ship with the raw Amazon tracking number (TBA…). With automatic ordering off, that means all of your orders. Once a tracking number has been sent to eBay it cannot be changed. Are you sure you want to turn it off?

address.title: Seller address
address.description: Published as the item location on your eBay listings. eBay shows buyers only the city, region and country.

listingRules.title: Listing rules
listingRules.subtitle: Decide what gets listed before anything is sent to eBay

brand.title: Brand protection
brand.veroHint: Skips products from brands known to report listings through eBay's VeRO program. eBay removes a reported listing and counts it against your account.
brand.veroOffWarning: With protection off, products from brands that report listings on eBay are listed like any other. A VeRO report can get your eBay account restricted.
brand.hideBrand: Don't send the brand to eBay
brand.hideBrandHint: The listing is published without a brand: the brand is taken out of the title and the item specifics, and no barcode or part number is sent, because eBay's catalog would put the brand back.

filters.title: What may be listed
filters.priceHint: Leave a field empty for no limit. A product priced outside the range is skipped, and the job shows why.
filters.priceError: The maximum must not be lower than the minimum.
filters.amazonShippedOnlyHint: Skips an offer that another seller ships from their own stock. Automatic ordering and tracking work best with products Amazon ships.
filters.ratingHint: A product with no rating yet is skipped when a minimum is set.

blockedAsins.title: Blocked ASINs
blockedAsins.placeholder: One ASIN per line, or separated by commas

cleanup.title: Automatic clean-up
cleanup.outOfStock: End a listing that stays out of stock
cleanup.outOfStockHint: The count starts again whenever the product is back in stock. A listing you paused yourself is never ended. An ended listing frees its place in your plan and is not relisted automatically.
cleanup.cold: Watch for listings that don't sell
cleanup.coldHint: A listing counts as not selling when it has had no sale for the number of days below. If it never sold, the days are counted from the day it was created.
cleanup.coldDaysError: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
cleanup.coldEndWarning: Listings are ended on eBay without asking you first, and they do not come back on their own. To review them yourself first, choose "Show them to me".

promoted.title: Promoted Listings
promoted.enableHint: Every listing published from here is added to a campaign on eBay at the ad rate below. eBay charges the rate only when an item sells through the ad. Listings that are already live are not changed.
promoted.rateHint: The price SellerHill calculates does not include this rate. Add it to the eBay fee of your listing settings group so your profit stays as planned.
promoted.ineligible: eBay does not let this store use Promoted Listings yet, so no ad will run until that changes. New listings are still published as usual.
promoted.ineligible_NOT_ENOUGH_ACTIVITY: eBay does not let this store use Promoted Listings yet: it reports not enough recent sales activity. No ad will run until that changes. New listings are still published as usual.
